patch_description: Implements the recommended Q-scheduling: the 2-state constant-velocity Kalman filter's process noise is now scaled per-step by local volatility, symmetrically with the already-winning volatility-adaptive R. Q_i = 0.05·q_scale²·(1 + v_i/median(v)) lets the filter stay rigid (fewer false reversals, better smoothness) in quiet regions while opening up to track genuine fast dynamics (lower lag error, better responsiveness). Keeps the np.linalg.solve-based RTS smoother and volatility-blended multi-scale zero-phase SG polish exactly as-is (no curvature state). Drops the risky slope-lead extrapolation that hurt false reversals in the current generation, relying instead on the flexible Q for responsiveness.
